change_summary: Material dawn update. The first completed synchronized owner burst began 5 seconds after civil dawn and ran 06:07:47–06:10:45 CDT; all six cameras were healthy. Four views had fair/good visibility and moderate detectability and showed only slightly rippled water, with no fish gulping/surfacing, shrimp concentration, swimming crabs, shoreline animal concentration, bird feeding, people, flashlights, clustered searching, collecting or temporal Jubilee signal in their visible areas. Two Point Clear views remained low-detectability, so their biological evidence is UNKNOWN. Direct Hazcams checks at 06:10–06:11 CDT advanced across two samples about 30.0 seconds apart. Grand Hotel showed no human/search/light signal; Fairhope showed ordinary service/vehicle activity and one possible worker near a utility truck, but no water-focused group, collecting, searching or handheld lights. Neither Fairhope beach is visible. Fresh 03Z NGOFS2 forecast guidance shifted to provisional shoreward transport over 1–6 hours (+22.02 m, +74.67 m, +72.52 m), then seaward at 12 hours (-243.51 m); this remains MODEL guidance. Direct local bottom oxygen and observed transport remain UNKNOWN. No credible September 8 first-person Jubilee report was found.
